questions.de: Wie heißt die deutsche Schauspielerin, die fast 20 Jahre lang im deutschen Fernsehen Kommissarin Rosa Roth gespielt hat?
questions.en: Which German actress played police inspector Rosa Roth on German television for almost 20 years?

timeline.labelEn: The ZDF crime series "Rosa Roth" starring Iris Berben runs for 31 episodes
timeline.labelDe: Die ZDF-Krimireihe „Rosa Roth“ mit Iris Berben läuft mit 31 Folgen

questions.cardDe: In welchem Land wurde der erste Rettungsschwimmer-Klub gegründet: USA, Australien oder Italien?
questions.de: In welchem Land wurde der erste Rettungsschwimmer-Klub gegründet?
questions.en: In which country was the first surf lifesaving club founded?

timeline.labelEn: Surf lifesaving begins in Sydney; Bondi Surf Bathers' Life Saving Club is recognised as the first club
timeline.labelDe: Rettungsschwimmen an Sydneys Stränden beginnt; der Bondi Surf Bathers' Life Saving Club gilt als erster Klub

questions.notes: Multiple choice reworked. Surf Life Saving Australia recognises Bondi (1907) as the first surf life saving club, though an organised group of lifesavers had formed on Manly Beach in 1899. Read as 'surf lifesaving club'; older general lifesaving societies existed elsewhere.

questions.en: What was Coco Chanel's favourite number?

timeline.labelEn: Chanel No. 5, Coco Chanel's first perfume, is released to select clients in Paris
timeline.labelDe: Chanel No. 5, Coco Chanels erstes Parfüm, wird ausgewählten Kundinnen in Paris vorgestellt

questions.notes: The number five had potent associations for Chanel from her convent childhood at Aubazine, and she named her first perfume after it.

questions.en: Which technical toy has become a nuisance worldwide because of its ability to intrude easily into private and public airspace?

timeline.labelEn: Electronically stabilised multicopters appear in series-produced models, paving the way for hobby drones
timeline.labelDe: Elektronisch stabilisierte Multicopter erscheinen in Serienmodellen und ebnen den Weg für Hobby-Drohnen

questions.notes: Hobby drones are mostly quadcopters/multicopters; the article dates series models with electronic stabilisation from about 2004.

questions.de: Welcher Film von 1981 machte genauso wie sein Remake von 2010 den Satz „Befreit den Kraken!“ populär?
questions.en: Which 1981 film, like its 2010 remake, made the line "Release the Kraken!" popular?

timeline.labelEn: "Clash of the Titans", with Ray Harryhausen's effects, is released in the US
timeline.labelDe: „Kampf der Titanen“ mit Effekten von Ray Harryhausen kommt in den USA ins Kino

questions.notes: Zeus orders the Kraken released; the 2010 remake (released 2 April 2010) turned Liam Neeson's 'Release the Kraken!' into an internet meme. German title: 'Kampf der Titanen'.
